Risk_Title: Spatial Representativeness Uncertainty Misinterpretation at Flanders Bay
Impact_Description: Expanding comparison uncertainty to +-30.5 m/yr reduces gate misfit to -1.12 sigma, but risks creating complacency by treating representation error as physical validation.
Mitigation_Strategy: Stage 3B calibration must anchor directly to the discrete flux gate cell velocity (175.85 m/yr -> 210.0 m/yr) rather than relying on spatial representativeness uncertainty to mask friction bias.

Risk_Title: Misinterpretation of C_schoof as a Physical Invariant
Impact_Description: Treating C_schoof as a universal physical constant masks lumped SMB, firn compaction, and bathymetry uncertainties.
Mitigation_Strategy: Formally register C_schoof as a reduced-complexity empirical correction factor. Strictly decouple its calibration from C_bed via sequential hierarchy.

Risk_Title: Residual Ill-Conditioning in Reduced Parameter Inversion
Impact_Description: If active parameter count exceeds independent observation rank, inversion Hessian becomes singular.
Mitigation_Strategy: Freezing A_glen, h_exp, and kappa_shape reduces condition number from 1.8e18 to 9.07 (3-param) and 16.54 (5-param), guaranteeing full rank and well-posedness.

Risk_Title: Temporal Transience Mismatch on Crane Glacier Basal Friction
Impact_Description: Inverting C_bed on post-collapse Crane Glacier without synchronizing geometry to 2011-2016 velocity epoch introduces severe friction bias.
Mitigation_Strategy: Enforce temporal synchronization between BedMachine V4.1 geometry and MEaSUREs 2011-2016 InSAR composite. Treat C_bed as conditionally identifiable.
